unit.why: A short anecdote: on Rosh Hashana and Yom Kippur the Apta rebbe had too many petitions (kvitlekh) to read, so he put them all in his pockets and blessed everyone who had written them.

stories.start_quote: שפ"א הי' לפני הרה״ק מאפטא הרבה קוויטליך
stories.end_quote: אריכא ומזוני רויחא ושנה טובה עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: On Rosh Hashana and Yom Kippur the Apta rebbe had no time to read his many petitions, so he put them all in his large pockets, laid his hands on them and blessed every petitioner with children, life, sustenance and a good year.

tags.why: Set on Rosh Hashana and Yom Kippur

quotes: ולא הספיק לו העת לקרותם כולם
tags.why: The rebbe deals with his followers' petitions

quotes: אני מברך את כל האנשים של הקוויטליך
tags.why: The tsaddik's blessing acts on behalf of his petitioners
The large pockets of his garments serve the blessing
